requirements.text: Play a game that demonstrates your knowledge of dinosaurs, such as a dinosaur match game.
Create an imaginary dinosaur. Share with your den its name, what it eats, and where it lives.

children.text: Make a dinosaur dig. Be a paleontologist, and dig through a dinosaur dig made by another member of your den. Show and explain the ways a paleontologist works carefully during a dig.

requirements.text: Make edible fossil layers. Explain how this snack is a good model for the formation of fossils.
